sections.title: Safety Bulletin Board Posting Audit Log
sections.html:
Policy Summary: This form supports MISH 07 by verifying required safety notices are posted and legible on each active site.

Procedure Capture: Confirm required posting set, revision currency, and visibility location for worker access.

Task Use: Supervisors complete the audit at mobilization and weekly thereafter, then file with project safety records.
